description: KU-MG1: A Dataset for Hybrid Photovoltaic-Natural Gas Generator Microgrid Model of a Residential Area. (For Nirala residential area, Khulna, Bangladesh) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Abdullah-Al Nahid. A renewable energy resource-based sustainable microgrid model for a residential area is designed by HOMER PRO microgrid software. Coverage: national (BD); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
